title: Zena Office
description: Zena Office S.r.l. is a regional small-to-mid-sized IT and office technology provider based in Piacenza, Italy, formally registered around 2000 and claiming roots that stretch back to 1930s office-furniture tradition, that with roughly 9–10 employees and about €2.2 million in annual revenue serves local businesses and public-procurement clients with an end-to-end mix of computer, peripheral and software retail, cybersecurity, ERP, cloud backup, enterprise networking, smart working and videoconferencing, multifunction printer and operational leasing, office furniture and custom software, partnering with vendors such as Microsoft, HP, Lenovo, VMware and Veeam, primarily through zenaoffice.it while also holding the largely unused zenaware.it domain.
